text:
samuel: Heads-up — after the py/ts SDK header rename landed in canary, console quota tiles show ~30% drop in attributed requests for some tenants. Anyone else seeing this? :eyes:

lina: yep saw it in staging, quota metrics are coming from route-header, mismatch between 'X-Route' and 'X-Route-Meta' we started emitting.

aj: timeline? which deploy introduced it?

samuel: yesterday PR #4821 — python SDK changed header case + compacted route meta. Example:
```http
X-Route: tenant-123|policy=fast
X-Route-Meta: {"quota_bucket":"team-a"}
```
now SDK sends:
```http
x-route: tenant-123|policy=fast
x-routemeta: team-a
```

maria: ah the console mapper expects JSON in X-Route-Meta, and header casing normalization broke the aggregator.

aj: casing shouldn't matter usually, but our internal proxy canonicalizes; looks like prefix removal in proxy broke for the compact name.

kevin: quick fix options: 1) rollback SDK header change, 2) add compatibility in proxy to canonicalize new names, 3) console can accept both shapes (harder).

lina: rolling back feels heavy — it was meant to reduce header size for perf.

samuel: proposal: proxy shim to rewrite x-routemeta -> X-Route-Meta with JSON shape by expanding compact value to {"quota_bucket":"..."} for now. then plan console ingest change and SDK docs.

aj: agree, proxy shim is lowest blast radius. who's oncall infra to ship?

maria: I can push a canary to staging now. will add tests for existing sample tenant.

lina: we should also add telemetry flag in SDK to opt into legacy header behavior for enterprise customers until console change finishes.

kevin: good call. add flag `ROUTE_META_LEGACY` default false; set true in customers that need it.

samuel: I'll update the rollout doc and add a console dashboard note explaining mismatch and ETA.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: proxy-shim-canary -> staging (maria)

maria: canary deployed, watching logs for header rewrite. @lina can you run quick regression against quota tiles?

lina: running now... will post results in 10m.

kevin: also add an alert if attributed quota drops >10% for >5m during rollout.

lina: regressed numbers look good in staging, attribution back to normal. :thumbsup: 

samuel: nice. Next steps: (a) proxy shim to prod canary, (b) console ingest patch to accept compact header, (c) SDK opt-in flag + docs. I'll spin up a concise RFC.

aj: add runtime test in proxy to catch future header-name changes.

samuel: thanks folks — filing followups in GH issues. end.
